prompt: An alcohol with M⁺ = 74 shows a prominent peak at m/z = 56 (loss of 18). What's the fragmentation pathway?

options.label: Loss of H₂O (18 amu) — classic dehydration from alcohol M⁺
Loss of NH₃ (17 amu) — not relevant here

concepts: alcohol loss of water in MS
explanation: Alcohols readily lose H₂O (mass 18) in the mass spectrum via E1-type cleavage from M⁺•, giving an alkene cation. M-18 is a hallmark peak for alcohols. If also α-cleavage happens, you see M-R' alkyl loss too.
